item.title: LayerZero Launches ATLAS for Institutional Exchange Infrastructure
item.summary: LayerZero has introduced ATLAS, a new infrastructure platform designed to allow trading firms and financial institutions to operate their own branded exchanges without developing core systems for matching orders, clearing, settlement and risk management from the ground up.
